title: A sheaf of abelian groups on a basis extends to a sheaf on the space
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal B$ a set of open subsets of $X$ which is a basis of the topology and satisfies $U\cap V\in\mathcal B$ for all $U,V\in\mathcal B$. Let $F$ be a presheaf of abelian groups on $\mathcal B$: abelian groups $F(U)$ for $U\in\mathcal B$ and group homomorphisms $r_{U,V}:F(U)\to F(V)$ for $V\subseteq U$ in $\mathcal B$ with $r_{U,U}=\mathrm{id}$ and $r_{V,W}r_{U,V}=r_{U,W}$. Suppose that for every $U\in\mathcal B$ and every family $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ of members of $\mathcal B$ with $\bigcup_iU_i=U$ ($I$ arbitrary, possibly empty) and every family $s_i\in F(U_i)$ with $r_{U_i,U_i\cap U_j}(s_i)=r_{U_j,U_i\cap U_j}(s_j)$ for all $i,j$, there is exactly one $s\in F(U)$ with $r_{U,U_i}(s)=s_i$ for all $i$. Then there is a sheaf of abelian groups $F^{ext}$ on $X$ together with group isomorphisms $\iota_U:F^{ext}(U)\to F(U)$ for $U\in\mathcal B$ such that $\iota_V(t|_V)=r_{U,V}(\iota_U(t))$ for $V\subseteq U$ in $\mathcal B$ and $t\in F^{ext}(U)$.
